name: Lucas Alamán
contribution: A Mexican scientist, conservative statesman, historian, and writer.

checks.lead: Lucas Alamán (18 October 1792 – 2 June 1853) was a Mexican scientist, conservative statesman, historian, and writer. He came from an elite Guanajuato family and was well-traveled and highly educated.  He was an eyewitness to the early fighting in the Mexican War of Independence when he witnessed the troops of insurgent leader Miguel Hidalgo y Costilla sack Guanajuato City, an incident that informed his already conservative and antidemocratic thought.
